//: Default worker model. Change with /models in the TUI or per-launch via the run-* scripts.

provider.//deepseek: DeepSeek is recognized natively by OpenCode (models.dev). This block is only needed to pin custom model IDs or override the base URL. The API key comes from `opencode auth login` or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY — never put it here.
provider.//mimo: MiMo via OpenAI-compatible. Base URL is read from the MIMO_BASE_URL env var so it is never hardcoded. Key comes from MIMO_API_KEY (or `opencode auth login` for a custom provider). Verify the model IDs against MiMo's /models before spending credits.
provider.//local: OPTIONAL local OpenAI-compatible server (llama.cpp / Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio). Uncomment and set baseURL + the model id your server exposes. No API key needed for most local servers; use a dummy if the SDK requires one.
